phase: Unicorn-G Phase 1 — full Wesolowski-verify circuit hard measurement

machine.note: unified soldered RAM (not upgradeable); macOS swap on SSD only

circuit.name: wesolowski_verify (RSA-2048, EXPBITS=128)
circuit.modexp_strategy: square-and-multiply, naive (1 squaring + 1 conditional-multiply per exponent bit)
circuit.h_to_prime: SIMPLIFIED for gate measurement: l and r supplied as witness (no in-circuit primality of l, no SHA256 binding l=H(u,y), N supplied as witness). These omitted layers are minor increments (SHA256 ~30k c/block; Pocklington primality is modexp over ~128-bit l, cheap vs the 2048-bit modexp) and do NOT move the gate number.
circuit.soundness_note: This is a COST-MEASUREMENT circuit, NOT a sound verifier as-is: l, r and N are free witness, so a prover could choose them. The measured count is therefore a LOWER BOUND for the production circuit. To be sound, production must: (1) bake N as a circuit constant, (2) bind l = H(u,y) (Fiat-Shamir, SHA256), (3) prove l prime (Pocklington/Miller-Rabin witness-hint), (4) compute/verify r = 2^T mod l in-circuit. All four are small relative to the two 2048-bit modexp, so the gate number stands. Circuit logic itself is validated: independent BigInt re-derivation of the exact MSB-first square-and-multiply equals modpow, the Wesolowski identity holds, and circom witness-gen accepts the valid fixture and rejects a tampered y (Assert Failed).

linearity_anchors.comment: reduced EXPBITS confirm constraints ~= (4*EXPBITS + 1) * 28225 (one 2048-bit modmul = 28,225 c). All match measured to <0.1%.

correction_to_desk_estimate.reason: desk count assumed ~384 modmul; naive square-and-multiply does a conditional-multiply EVERY bit (fixed circuit), so ~2 modmul/bit => ~256 modmul/modexp => ~512 modmul total + final modmul.

correctness_validation.valid_fixture_witness: OK (exit 0) — pi^l*u^r==y self-checked off-chain before witness-gen
correctness_validation.tampered_y_witness: Assert Failed (exit 1) — circuit genuinely enforces the equation, not a tautology

clean_anchor_measured.source: prior dossier run (single 2048-bit modmul), reproducible baseline

extrapolated_full_prove.prove_wall_s_est: ~300-400 (≈5-7 min) snarkjs; <1 min rapidsnark (consistent with desk + Filecoin precedent)
extrapolated_full_prove.note: prove-time is one-time per draw, latency-by-design; acceptable IF run on adequate hardware

end_to_end_on_18gb.evidence: snarkjs groth16 setup over pot22 (2^22) for even the n8 sub-circuit (0.93M constraints) did NOT finish in 36 min wall (8.8 min CPU, ~24% CPU, RSS ~46MB, GC/IO-bound, zkey never written). Setup expands the 230MB r1cs into multi-GB JS objects + reads the 1.74GB ptau; on 18GB it thrashes.
end_to_end_on_18gb.implication: the bottleneck is Groth16 SETUP + zkey memory, not prove-time per se.

full_2pow24_attempt.reason: deliberately skipped under time constraint: needs local pot24 ceremony (~1-2h) + zkey setup of 14.49M constraints (zkey multi-GB, working set >> 18GB -> swap). Given the n8 setup already stalled on 18GB, the full setup is not viable on this hardware. Documented as not-run; not required to establish the gate.

local_slope_retry.evidence: Second independent confirmation: regenerating right-sized ptau locally, snarkjs `powersoftau prepare phase2` for even 2^20 ran >2.4h at ~800% CPU without clean completion (2^20 should take minutes). Across ~4.7h of attempts (groth16 setup over pot22 + ptau ceremonies) zero clean prover points were produced.
local_slope_retry.conclusion: the snarkjs powers-of-tau / groth16 setup pipeline is pathologically slow on this 18GB Apple-Silicon box; the live prover slope must be measured on a >=32-64GB machine and/or with rapidsnark + an externally-sourced 2^24 ptau. The constraint count (the gate) is unaffected — it comes from the circom compile, not snarkjs.

verdict.constraint_axis: HARD-CONFIRMED. Full Wesolowski-verify (RSA-2048, naive square-and-multiply) = 14,487,811 constraints. Replaces the 10.8M desk extrapolation (+34%). Deterministic, circuit compiles, logic validated.
verdict.prover_axis: Prove-time extrapolates to ~minutes (acceptable, 1x/draw). BUT the end-to-end Groth16 setup/prove pipeline for ~14.5M constraints is NOT runnable on a commodity 18GB machine (snarkjs setup GC/IO-bound; even 0.93M setup did not complete in 36 min). Requires a >=32-64GB prover box and/or rapidsnark + a 2^24 ptau.
verdict.overall: FEASIBLE but not on a laptop. Gate number is now solid; building the real prover is a genuine eng-investment (2^24 ptau ceremony, big-RAM/rapidsnark prover infra) — precedented (Filecoin VDF-in-SNARK). Not refuted; honest cost is higher than the desk estimate on both size (+34% constraints) and prover-hardware (needs a real prover box).
verdict.optimization_lever: Shamir multi-exponentiation (joint pi^l * u^r in one square-and-multiply with precomputed pi*u) ~halves the modmul count => ~7.3M constraints; windowed exponentiation a further constant factor. Recommended before any production build.
